cwe_content.cwe: CWE-89,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

candidate.Code: cursor.execute(f"SELECT term FROM terms WHERE term > \"{floor}\" AND term < \"{ceiling}\" AND term LIKE \"{word}%%\" ORDER BY length(term),term LIMIT {requested_limit}")
candidate.Reason: Direct string interpolation of user-controlled variables (word, floor, ceiling, requested_limit) into SQL query without parameterization, matching CWE-89 SQL Injection characteristics

candidate.Code: cursor.execute(f"SELECT rowid, fragment FROM cached_fragments WHERE fragment == \"{word_part}\"")
candidate.Reason: Direct string interpolation of user-controlled variable (word_part) into SQL query without parameterization, matching CWE-89 SQL Injection characteristics

candidate.Code: cursor.execute(f"SELECT term FROM cached_fragment_terms WHERE fragment_id = {fragment_id} AND term LIKE \"%%{word}%%\"")
candidate.Reason: Direct string interpolation of user-controlled variables (fragment_id, word) into SQL query without parameterization, matching CWE-89 SQL Injection characteristics

candidate.Code: cursor.execute("SELECT term FROM terms WHERE term LIKE \"%%%%%s%%%%\" ORDER BY length(term),term LIMIT %s" % (word,10000))
candidate.Reason: String formatting of user-controlled variable (word) into SQL query without parameterization, matching CWE-89 SQL Injection characteristics
